evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: In interactive systems where users engage with LLMs, users are adaptive and, after observing LLM responses, can change their prompting strategy, as well as the type and difficulty of subsequent tasks.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: We define two classes of estimands for comparing models: the common-distribution effect, which compares model performance on the same distribution of prompts, and the induced-distribution effect, which compares each model on the prompt distribution generated through user interaction.
